plan.name: Show every component evidence kind safely
plan.summary: Complete explicit component Markdown receipts alongside the existing optional JSON: keep every production component's independent proof row and add separate conformance, runtime, assumption and input-provenance views with exact identities, source and contract hashes, selections, invocation metadata, tool pins, model and bounds, observations, outcomes and diagnostics. Distinguish configuration from supplied results, qualify exhaustive states separately from successful nonempty attempt coverage, preserve independently successful runtime observations, and always label assumptions assumed/unverified; the prose and footer explain supplied results and declarations and that the API runs no tools, without aggregate assurance or changing the recorded gate outcome. Escape each original caller-controlled value before assembling markup, preserve visible characters and existing shortening, and retain report/JSON values, fingerprints, old proof-only compatibility and successful legacy Go, Python and TypeScript receipt bytes and unverified-function lists. Update SPEC.md and README.md, including their roadmaps, to remove the temporary proof-only Markdown limitation and describe completed evidence/provenance and preservation rules while retaining verify.ErrComponents before tools start, Go-only component discovery, verify.RunModel, and the separate later dashboard and execution work; changed SPEC bullets cite D-0013, D-0024, D-0029, D-0082, D-0122, D-0135, D-0152, D-0158, D-0161, D-0163 and the applicable D-0168 through D-0172 decisions, and the merger records the remaining receipt-policy roll-up refining D-0169 because this build cannot write decisions/. Update only the intentional proof-only expectations in the existing conformance/runtime receipt tests while retaining their attribution, escaping and compatibility checks, add the supplied-API acceptance coverage, and run the relevant project/verify/receipt tests and the root Go test suite without real verifiers or changes to ratified statements or locks.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptsExposeEveryIndependentEvidenceKind
tests.says: An API-built report shows independent proof, conformance, runtime and assumptions on one target, a conformance-only neighbor, an assumption-only target, an unchecked proof-contract helper and targets without results, with input-only tests and drivers in separate provenance; each kind exposes supplied identities, hashes, pins, metadata, outcomes and diagnostics in JSON and Markdown without whole-project or every-size assurance.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptConformanceClaimsRequireTheRightObservations
tests.says: Conformance identifies sampled or bounded-exhaustive observations and their counts separately from attempts; positive matching exhaustive states with absent attempts can establish every state but never every step, failed or empty attempt checks qualify that claim without erasing successful observations, and failed, timed-out, skipped, empty or missing outcomes never become successful evidence.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptRuntimeDoesNotInferExerciseFromProcessSuccess
tests.says: Runtime receipts retain process, selected test and assertion identities, actual exercise, input provenance, outcomes and diagnostics independently; passing processes do not invent tests or assertions or target coverage, while qualifying successful child observations survive failed enclosing outcomes.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptSelectionsCompatibilityAndNoFabricatedResults
tests.says: Configuration-only selections and assumptions are visible without fabricated results; absent new JSON kinds remain optional, old proof-only JSON round trips render truthfully despite stale aggregate labels, and legacy Go/Python/TypeScript Markdown, fingerprints and unverified-function lists remain unchanged.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptEvidenceHostileOriginalValues
tests.says: Hostile identities, assumption text and origins, paths and hashes, invocation metadata, model and bound values, tool pins, observations, diagnostics and footer values remain visibly exact inert text, without double escaping, links, injected HTML, rows, cells or forged component/status associations; rendering and JSON round trips preserve report values, fingerprint and gate outcome.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptEvidenceUntrustedModeOutcomesAndStatuses
tests.says: Defensive rendering of decoded API-built reports keeps hostile mode, outcome and status strings inert and never turns them or stale qualifications into success, exhaustive-state or every-step claims, and assumptions remain assumed/unverified.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptEvidenceOptionalJSONRemainsRenderable
tests.says: Missing optional metadata and absent supplied records render without panic or invented success, preserve JSON and fingerprint, and retain the explicit receipt's truthful no-tools and supplied-data explanation.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptBindsInputsAcrossEditsOrderAndRelocation
tests.says: Real selected driver, test, fixture, configuration, dependency, module, model/include, bounds-source and assumption-source byte edits change their receipt snapshots and fingerprint, outside-scope driver edits do not add production coverage, and canonical set ordering and checkout relocation preserve report, JSON, fingerprint and Markdown.

tests.name: TestComponentReceiptPreservesIndependentUpdatesAndRejectsStaleKinds
tests.says: Each supplied API replaces or clears only its own kind while the receipt preserves other kinds, legacy checks and gate outcome; all four reject stale retained cross-kind input evidence atomically, preserving JSON, fingerprint and rendered evidence on rejection.
